title: Check record access through lazy exact lookups of reachable dependencies
context: Access checks eagerly indexed all state records, causing restricted capture replay to enumerate collections despite its exact-lookup requirement. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.); con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex).
decision: Replace eager indexing and global restriction propagation with cached ID lookups and iterative traversal of reachable dependencies. Determine restricted mode from explicit options or partition capability declarations.
consequences: Derived, receipt, and commitment records use prefix-validated direct lookups.
Hidden dependencies withhold complete records without modifying authenticated content.
Iterative traversal handles dependency cycles and deep chains.
The regression test requires replay to reuse the record ID without enumerating derived records and rejects an outsider.
Restricted mode relies on declared protection rather than scanning record visibility.
alternatives_rejected: Eagerly enumerate all records and compute a global fixed point of blocked dependents.

rejected_tripwires.alternative: Eagerly enumerate all records and compute a global fixed point of blocked dependents.
